title: Dark storefront glazing system
notes: Dark anodised aluminium storefront: gray glass, black-glass mullions every 2 blocks (Detail pp.3-4), charcoal piers and fascia. Backing is light gray concrete so the gray glass does not go black (Detail p.5: no black behind gray/black glass). Intended for the glazed zone under an opaque band; pair with a stucco palette zone for the band.
